title: GPU dashboard snapshot — ops scrapbook (weekly rollup)
body:
Context:
Exported Grafana dashboard: /d/gpu-util/cluster-pool-rollup (window: 2026-06-11 -> 2026-06-18). This is the weekly ops scrapbook derived from the daily snapshots; purpose: quick human-readable rollup for oncall + capacity planning sync.

Notes to self / high-level takeaways:
- Fleet-wide average core GPU utilization (weighted by slot-hours) ~ 62%. Slight uptick vs last week (+3ppt) driven by APAC traffic.
- P95 token-serving latency correlated with pool saturation windows in eu-west-1 between 03:40-04:20 UTC on 2026-06-14. See ticket INFRA-7243.
- Microburst events continue to show up on cluster-gamma-2 (pool: infer-small) — recurring short spikes that cause ~2–4 min queue build and then catchup. Not purely request rate; suspect KV cache warm path.
- Idle fragmentation: several dedicated pools in na-east have > 18% fragmented idle sockets (slots available but too small for incoming burst shapes).

Top tables (derived from dashboard export):
Columns: cluster | pool | region | avg_util_pct | p95_util_pct | idle_slots | backfilled_pct | peak_concurrent | notes
cluster-alpha-1 | infer-large | us-east-1 | 78 | 94 | 2 | 11 | 84 | sustained load from customer-X nightly batch (03:00-05:00)
cluster-beta-3  | embed-medium  | eu-west-1 | 61 | 87 | 6 | 24 | 42 | steady; p95 spikes during EU morning window
cluster-gamma-2 | infer-small  | apac-south1 | 55 | 91 | 4 | 18 | 120 | repeated microburst pattern; investigate KV cache miss ratio
cluster-delta-4 | reserved-burst | us-west-2 | 33 | 65 | 14 | 6 | 20 | headroom available; candidate for short-term burst routing
cluster-eps-6   | private-prod  | eu-central-1 | 71 | 89 | 1 | 9 | 66 | high priority customer pinned models active

Derived metrics (notes):
- backfilled_pct: fraction of window where spare slots were used by best-effort/burst workloads. Pools with >20% are being used as soft overflow — monitor for noisy neighbors.
- idle_slots: reported free slot count at daily snapshot time (08:00 UTC) — useful for morning surge headroom.

Anomalies & Suspected Root Causes:
- cluster-gamma-2 microbursts: correlation matrix shows 72% overlap with requests that touch long context models + function-calling. Hypothesis: async KV cache eviction due to variant-serving churn. Action: instrument KV hit/miss logs and enable prefix cache sticky routing for a 24h trial. Owner: Vikram Shah. Ticket: INFRA-7243.
- eu-west-1 p95 latency spikes: traffic shift from embed-medium to embed-large during EU business hours; autoscaler thresholds not aggressive enough for 1–2 minute ramps. Action: lower scale-up threshold for embed pools by 10% and add 90s cooldown. Owner: Maya Chen. Linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/429

Capacity planning signals (ops recommendations):
- Short-term (next 7 days): allocate +2 slots to cluster-gamma-2 infer-small pool during APAC night window (00:00-06:00 local) and enable burst routing to reserved-burst pools in us-west-2 for spillover.
- Medium-term (2–6 weeks): schedule a rebalance of reserved-burst capacity: move 1 rack from us-west-2 reserved-burst -> na-east general pool to reduce fragmentation; expected reduction in fragmented idle sockets by ~7%.
- Long-term: evaluate model placement policies to reduce KV-cache churn for multi-variant models (esp. function-calling workloads). Consider sticky model routing by tenant for high-churn customers.

Operational checklist (quick wins):
- [ ] Add KV hit/miss counters to cluster-gamma-2 (owner: Vikram Shah) — target: 2026-06-23
- [ ] Lower embed pool scale-up threshold (owner: Maya Chen) — target: 2026-06-20; rollout in canary region first
- [ ] Create route policy to prefer reserved-burst pools only after 60s sustained queue depth > 3 (owner: Owen Patel) — target: 2026-06-22

Raw export metadata:
- grafana_export_id: gf-2026-06-18-ops-001
- export_query: cluster_pool_rollup_v2 (window=7d, sample=5m)
- snapshot_time: 2026-06-18T08:07:00Z
- generated_by: ops-dashboard-exporter v1.14.2

Freeform / scratch (notes typed during pager shift):
- "if KV warm path is the issue, we might see elevated memory churn + kernel stalls; check node-level dmesg around 03:40 on June 14"
- "customer-X batch could be shifted earlier by 30m if they accept; ops to reach out if short-term headroom insufficient"
- "consider a small user-facing note: transient delays may be seen in EU mornings while we adjust autoscaling"

Links / references inline:
- ticket INFRA-7243: root cause trix for cluster-gamma-2 microburst (investigation ongoing)
- PR #429: autoscaler tuning for embed pools (staged config change)
- slack thread: #gpu-ops 2026-06-18 ops-scrapbook (contains raw charts + PNGs)

Next steps / owner summary:
- Vikram Shah: instrument KV metrics + run 24h sticky routing trial (target start: 2026-06-22)
- Maya Chen: autoscaler threshold change + canary monitor (target rollout: 2026-06-20)
- Owen Patel: implement spillover routing policy for reserved-burst (target: 2026-06-22)

If anything here looks off or you want a focused CSV extract for a specific cluster/pool/time window, ping me and I'll paste the raw slice.
